notes: S2/F50/F39 (§9.1 rule 1, T1, §14.5): the declaration's public_key is the malformed AAAA and its body.key is a number. A malformed public_key is decided before E_KIND_BODY_SCHEMA and before key resolution (step (4)), so it wins over the body.key defect, and no signature check runs: sigs is [] (§14.6).
